method: Surface-by-surface read adjudication. The generated all-surface active-code Atlas and Bridge comparison were used only as navigation; active-code records below are backed by normative, source, test, and registry/proof evidence read for this pass.
limitation_statement: This is static structural/read evidence only. Test execution status is recorded separately in the validation report and receipts.
surface_limitation: This pass covers ACATQ-0040 / ACABC-0041 donor db.* missing/new-test-family records only. It does not admit SQLAlchemy schema/seed/engine behaviour, original donor db package recreation, or runtime trading persistence policy.

records.title: Persistence package boundary exports only the active native receipt-ledger surface, not donor db schema/seed/engine APIs
records.observed_behaviour_from_read_evidence: The active persistence package re-exports ReceiptLedger only. The new Tier A test locks out donor db.* API names such as Base, create_engine_from_url, create_session_factory, create_schema, and seed_dev_data from that package boundary.
records.test_first_gap_or_action: ACABC-0041 required a new Tier A family for missing donor db.* records. The new family proves the active package boundary rather than recreating the donor db package.
adjudication_notes: The donor db.* records were treated as intent-navigation inputs only, not as source implementation authority.
No source repair was opened because the active package boundary already passed the new blocker.
limitations: This record does not claim that all future persistence/schema migration work is complete.
This record does not inspect original donor Atlas JSON as source truth; Bridge/join files were used only for queue navigation.

records.title: PersistenceSessionFactory is a bounded in-memory session seam, not an external engine/sessionmaker seam
records.observed_behaviour_from_read_evidence: PersistenceSessionFactory.session yields a fresh InMemoryPersistenceSession for each context. The new Tier A test proves session isolation and rejects accidental exposure of external-engine, sessionmaker, declarative Base, schema, and seed helper surfaces on the active session module.
records.test_first_gap_or_action: A distinct new Tier A family was admitted before any source mutation. The bounded test passes against current source, so donor db session/seed ideas remain unimplemented and source repair stayed closed.
adjudication_notes: This is a boundary/non-admission blocker, not an implementation of SQL-backed persistence.
The native seam remains thin by blueprint status; this pass records the active seam honestly rather than upgrading maturity.
limitations: This record does not prove database durability, migrations beyond the existing lifecycle placeholder, or seed-data semantics.
This pass did not inspect or mutate dependencies, VENV configuration, or original donor Atlas/Bridge JSON.
